tools.name: webshell_gen
tools.description: Generate a web shell payload (PHP/JSP/ASP/ASPX). Types: cmd (command exec), eval (eval code), reverse (reverse shell). Optional obfuscation and password protection.

tools.name: webshell_upload
tools.description: Upload a web shell to a target via file upload vulnerability. Auto-discovers upload endpoints and verifies shell accessibility.

tools.name: websocket_test
tools.description: Test WebSocket endpoints — origin validation, CSWSH, Socket.IO detection.

tools.name: whois_lookup
tools.description: Query WHOIS for domain registration information.

tools.name: wordpress_scan
tools.description: Scan WordPress site — version, plugins, themes, XML-RPC, REST API, exposed paths.

tools.name: wpscan_check
tools.description: WordPress vulnerability scanner. Requires wpscan CLI.

tools.name: xss_detect
tools.description: Bounded XSS HTTP reflection tests. request_json preserves flat json/data, headers and cookies. Authenticated body browser replay is not supported; reflection is not execution.

tools.name: xss_exploit
tools.description: Generate PoC XSS exploit payloads and steal links. Types: reflected, stored, dom_based, bypass_waf, cookie_steal.

tools.name: xsstrike_check
tools.description: XSS vulnerability detection. Requires xsstrike CLI.

tools.name: xxe_detect
tools.description: Test for XML External Entity injection vulnerabilities.
